label: Impact-checklist items at the first audit (b9b6d3a, 2026-07-27)
Upstream releases audited (audit reports)
command: git -C gs-fortress ls-tree --name-only ff5ff42 ledger/reports/ | grep -cE '/audit-[0-9.]+\.md$'

label: Build-kickoff files (change plans handed to build sessions)
command: git -C gs-fortress ls-tree --name-only ff5ff42 ledger/reports/ | grep -cE '/build-kickoffs-[0-9.]+\.md$'

label: Vendor-ready defect reports on file
command: git -C gs-fortress ls-tree --name-only ff5ff42 ledger/upstream-feedback/reports/ | grep -c '\.md$'

label: Defect reports recorded as acknowledged
command: git -C gs-fortress show ff5ff42:ledger/known-issues.json | grep -cE '"acknowledged": "[0-9]{4}-' || true

label: Resolved defects that had a report on file
Tracked defects carrying the 2026-07-30 vendor reply
Bus findings reopened at least once (by a tester or the owner)
command: git -C gs-fortress show ff5ff42:dev/FEEDBACK.md ff5ff42:dev/FEEDBACK-archive.md | awk '/^## F-[0-9]+/{f=$2} /^Reopened/{print f}' | sort -u | wc -l

label: Test suites (*.test.mjs)
command: git -C gs-fortress ls-tree -r --name-only ff5ff42 plugins/gs-fortress/test | grep -cE '\.test\.mjs$'

label: Watcher invariants restated to every agent
command: git -C gs-fortress show ff5ff42:plugins/gs-fortress/skills/gs-admin-cli-watch/SKILL.md | sed -n '/^## Invariants/,/^## Stage 0/p' | grep -cE '^[0-9]+\. '

label: dev-loop findings on this repo's own bus
command: git -C gs-fortress show ff5ff42:dev/FEEDBACK.md ff5ff42:dev/FEEDBACK-archive.md | grep -oE '^## F-[0-9]+' | sort -u | wc -l
